text:
olivia: Quick sync: follow-up on pin/rollout metadata schema. We keep talking about compat refs but haven't settled tenant-level overrides and token size. want to align on a compact on-path token + richer off-path doc.

sam: agreed. proposal: runtime-visible token is fixed 16 bytes (base62) that resolves to a control-plane doc. token encodes a tiny TLV: 4b ref_id, 4b cohort, 4b flags, 4b checksum. keeps network headers tiny.

maria: strong +1 for small token. observability caveat: if token is opaque we must ensure control plane emits mapping events: token -> human ref + schema_version so logs are debuggable. add `resolved_ref` and `schema_ver` fields to telemetry.

dinesh: runtime note: we can't re-resolve tokens synchronously on the hot path. SDKs should cache token->doc mapping with TTL and background refresh. runtime will accept token and consult local resolver; miss triggers async fetch and short-circuit to fallback when needed.

kevin: ops question: how do tenant overrides work? ops want ability to pin a tenant to a legacy model for longer without changing the global ref. need a clear precedence: tenant_override > rollout_ref > default_ref. plus an expiration for overrides.

olivia: propose `override_anchor` concept: control-plane stores per-tenant anchor entries with expiry and optional justification. runtime checks anchor first. anchor object lives as off-path doc. on-path token stays unchanged.

anjali: client SDK UX: when a tenant has an override we should surface it in SDK config and provide a warning hook. e.g., SDK.onPinOverride(tenant, anchor_meta). helps apps detect long-running overrides.

sam: encoding detail: TLV idea is good. but make sure bitfields are forward-compatible. reserve high bits for future usage and include a version nibble.

maria: telemetry mapping: emit both token and resolved_ref in traces and span attributes. also record `anchor_source` if an override was applied (ops|admin-api|migration-tool).

dinesh: runtime API: add a lightweight probe endpoint `/v1/pin-info?tenant=...` that returns token, resolved_ref, effective_fallback_list, and applied_anchor_id. return minimal JSON for ops. keep rate limits.

kevin: runbook: when anchor expiry nears, send automated notice to tenant contact + create a rollback alert if error rate spikes after anchor change. we should also include `grace_window_seconds` in anchor metadata so runtime can allow a soft-fallback period.

olivia: sketch of anchor document (human readable, stored off-path):
```json
{
  "anchor_id": "anch-2026-04-09-42",
  "tenant": "acme-corp",
  "pinned_ref": "model-v3.1",
  "expires_at": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z",
  "reason": "payment-related rollback",
  "grace_window_seconds": 600
}
```

sam: minor: make `expires_at` optional and require a mandatory `max_renewals` or audit fields so anchors don't become infinite by accident.

anjali: add an SDK flag `honor_tenant_anchors: true|false` allowing apps to opt-out of tenant-level anchors for special workloads. must be admins-only.

maria: QA: add a test matrix for anchor expiry, toolkit-driven anchor injection, and telemetry correlation. we should be able to replay a workload with recorded tokens to validate legacy behavior.

dinesh: perf: cache eviction policy for token resolvers should include LRU + pinned entries for tenants with anchors. avoid N^2 growth in memory.

pin-bot: :pushpin: Anchor created: anch-2026-04-09-42 for tenant acme-corp, expires 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z.

kevin: ops action: i'll add anchor expiry alerts and a dashboard for unresolved tokens > 1h. also add canary gating: if a canary-ref introduces new required fields, control plane should block auto-upgrade for tenants with `honor_tenant_anchors=false` until opt-in.

olivia: next steps: (1) sam to produce TLV token draft + sample encoder/decoder, (2) dinesh to spec probe endpoint and cache behavior, (3) maria to write telemetry mapping doc, (4) kevin to add ops runbook entries for anchors and dashboard. i'll PR the anchor schema and precedence rules tomorrow.

sam: will prototype encoder today.

maria: will add telemetry checklist to the PR.

dinesh: will sketch the probe response shape.

kevin: will coordinate alerts with SRE.
